subject: Re: KIP status: positioning decision + freeze-week logistics
body:
Team,

Two calls ahead of the Jul 20 readout.

1) Positioning: v1 is the fast-iteration/CI story only. With a 4-6% finite-network gap (8% on our tabular corpus), I'm not standing behind data-minimization claims this quarter — that pitch returns when the gap narrows or when Label Solve on a curated support set closes it for specific corpora. Yara, one slide quantifying LS-vs-KIP cost and quality would really help here.

2) Freeze logistics: Chiara got the schema approved and registered the first three distilled sets in Corpus v2 yesterday — one day inside the freeze, closer than I'd like but done. Remaining sets are read-only demos so they can wait out the freeze window.

Readout invite going out today; Bao, please sanity-check the compute-cost appendix, the A100-hour numbers are doing a lot of work in the ROI slide.

Dmitri
